style: stylized 3D cartoon, original design, vivid saturated colors, high contrast
subject: ONE ginger hamster, cat-sized; cheeks twice his head width, coin rim showing; skinny from 5.0 to 9.2
second_characters: the cashier: voice and right hand only
props: ONE huge open sack of sunflower seeds, tall as him, seeds spilling; ONE loaf of bread; her rubber divider; ONE terminal, cracked screen, bendy neck; ONE coin saucer; ONE blank card
